purpose: Execute the already-defined E07 Hosted mall-opening and Sovereign-upgrade continuity claim and preserve independently recountable identity, lineage, history, infrastructure, state-timeline, manifest, pointer and rollback evidence. This record mirrors the active E2.0 trace matrix and does not create or expand a product contract.

production Sovereign upgrade, four-step resource/manifest state machine and rollback contract
runtime adapter for the registered opening and upgrade operations

regression_basis.role: existing opening continuity, rollback, concurrency and isolation regression
existing upgrade lineage, resource, failure-recovery and rollback regression

transition_sequence: consumer Hosted to operating_mall Hosted on the original node
selected operating_mall Hosted to operating_mall Sovereign on the original node
rollback selected Sovereign upgrades to the recorded Hosted relationship
allowed_opening_changes: mall_id null to one new mall

one hosted opening, operating-entity binding, hosted configuration, change and Outbox fact

independent_oracle.procedure: Independently join and compare every sample's node, Realm, Membership, account, principal, current relation and closure rows before opening, after opening, after selected upgrade and after rollback; recount only the prelocked allowed additions; recompute manifest digests, resource/timeline cardinalities, Hosted infrastructure deltas, non-target digests, history digests and source/build counts. Mutate copies to prove detection of unrelated lineage, Membership/level reset, node-specific source/build growth and another-node switch; do not consume runner PASS fields.

current lineage or immutable pre-transition history digest change count = 0
Hosted opening authority and allowed-addition mismatch count = 0

Sovereign resource readiness or uniqueness mismatch count = 0

positive_cases: All L3/L6/L8/L11 samples open a mall on the original Hosted node with one allowed capability append and no infrastructure call.
Only L6 and L8 become Sovereign on their original identities and produce complete, unique resource and manifest facts.
Rolling back both selected upgrades restores their recorded Hosted relationship while retaining opening facts and immutable history.
negative_cases: Detect an unrelated parent/lineage or another-node transition.
Detect a Membership, principal or signed-level reset.
Detect a source copy, per-node build, unexpected history rewrite or non-target switch.
unknown_rule: Missing any before/after immutable-key row, history digest, infrastructure count, opening result, upgrade timeline, resource row, manifest/pointer reference, target/non-target snapshot, rollback receipt, source/build observation or environment fact yields UNKNOWN.

outcome_table.condition: All required artifacts and fields exist; all four openings and both upgrades are complete; every locked identity, lineage, history, infrastructure, resource, manifest, non-target, source/build and rollback threshold is met; every negative mutation is detected.
Any complete raw observation contradicts a prelocked continuity, infrastructure, resource, isolation, source/build or rollback threshold.

Any required artifact, sample, transition, immutable key, history digest, infrastructure counter, timeline, resource, manifest, pointer, non-target snapshot, source/build fact, rollback receipt or environment field is missing or unreadable.

environment_classification: A successful disposable local PostgreSQL 17 execution with all migrations and synthetic non-production resource references can establish DEV VERIFIED only.
